scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.postbuild: if [ "$CI" = 'true' ]; then echo '[postbuild] uv sync — building .venv...'; cd ../../.. && uv sync --frozen --no-dev 2>&1 | tail -5 && echo '[postbuild] .venv ready' || echo '[postbuild] uv sync failed'; else echo '[postbuild] dev — skip'; fi
